tools.name: security-configuration_header-audit
tools.description: Read security headers from a public URL or from headers supplied by the caller. A missing header is a confirmed gap only when the response was available. This does not show that the site is secure. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/security-configuration/header-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 pa

tools.name: security-configuration_tls-audit
tools.description: Read the certificate from one public HTTPS request, or from certificate fields supplied by the caller. An old protocol, an expired certificate, a name mismatch, or an untrusted certificate is confirmed. This does not show that the site is secure. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/security-configuration

tools.name: security-configuration_cookie-audit
tools.description: Check Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite on Set-Cookie headers from one public response or from cookie lines supplied by the caller. Cookie values are not returned. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/security-configuration/cookie-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: security-configuration_cors-policy-audit
tools.description: Read CORS response headers. When an origin is supplied, it is sent once on the public GET. A wildcard, or a reflected origin with credentials, is confirmed. No other origins are tried. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/security-configuration/cors-policy-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment te

tools.name: security-configuration_csp-policy-analyze
tools.description: Read Content-Security-Policy from a public response or from policy text supplied by the caller. unsafe-inline, unsafe-eval, a script wildcard, and data: scripts are confirmed. tools.name: security-configuration_exposed-file-check
tools.description: Request only the paths the caller lists, on the same host as the supplied URL. A non-HTML HTTP 200 is a confirmed reachable path. No common-file list is guessed and the body is not copied. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/security-configuration/exposed-file-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payme

tools.name: security-configuration_public-endpoint-audit
tools.description: Send one GET to each listed public URL and record HTTPS, HSTS, and nosniff. Credential URLs and non-public addresses are not fetched. No login or credential test is attempted. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/security-configuration/public-endpoint-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms a

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "security-configuration" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow.
